bestBets.overview: UNFILTERED was good from the back at Hobart last week and should be hard fit after three runs this term. He's unknown on synthetic but is yet to run a bad race and must be respected. Former Victorian CHEF'S KISS was plain when heavily supported at his local debut at Hobart but has since had a quiet trial here and the rise to 1350m is a positive. GEE GEES BROTHER led and gave a sight at big odds fresh and can't be taken lightly this time. GUBER has been mixing form of late but has placed at both tries this route.

raceTips.comment: Unfiltered looks ready to win, he found the line nicely last start at Hobart. This looks a perfect race for him to break through now fully fit. Chiefs Kiss looks well placed here. Jock Rock has shown some ability in trials. Gee Gees Brother has place hopes.

bestBets.overview: The debutante DEER POWER draws awkwardly but has looked smart winning both trials at this track and should be kept very safe. HARRATA made good ground from the back when specked at healthy odds fresh and will be better for that hitout. EQUIVASTAR battled away soundly behind a dominant all-the-way victor last start and should get a gun run in transit from the inside alley. PENNINSULA ROSE battled away okay after facing the breeze here last time and can improve into minors.

raceTips.comment:
Deep Power finds a very winnable race here on debut and has trialled nicely in readiness for this Harrata found the line in ok style last start here at Devonport. 
Equivaster could get favours from barrier one with C Newitt on.

bestBets.overview: CHEROKEE DANCER is yet to miss a place in six fresh runs and her record at this track is also very consistent. She's tuned up for this with a trial win and draws to get all the favours. GEEGEES MISSILE has proved costly as a beaten fave at all three runs this time in but should be peaking now and drops in weight with the rise in grade. FURNEAUX failed to finish off in open company last start but this is easier and he had been holding form well prior. The speedster THOROS OF MYR is sure to be in it for a long way.

raceTips.comment: Geegees Misslie found the line nicely last start where she just got a little too far back. She looks set to peak third up. Cherokee Dancer should get a soft run here and likes this track. Thoros Of Myr will lead and give a sight.

bestBets.overview: HOULIHAN was plain when ridden quieter last start but had been good from on speed at her first three runs this time in. She can bounce back with a more positive ride. PARTY DAY found form quickly last time in and has tuned up for this with a pair of trial wins. SUPER SNIPPY has placed when new and boasts a solid record at this trip - check for support. GEEGEES MERCEDES disappointed at Hobart last week but had been holding form well prior and is deserving of another chance.

raceTips.comment: Party Day has trialled nicely and looks ready to win first up. C Newitt on board is a big positive, he's a progressive type that should be hard to beat first up. Houlihan is racing well but struggles to win of late.

bestBets.overview: STARDARMUS surprisingly led and bolted in here before trying hard behind an all-the-way victor when back to turf last week. He's back in trip on that but Newitt up is always a positive. Launceston Guineas placegetter WOLF JUNIOR will no doubt be peaking later, over further, but he found form quickly last time in and has tuned up for this with a pair of trial placings. QUICKEN UP has failed to finish off at both runs this term but has since won a pair of trials and should get every chance to improve from the kind draw. Track specialist ALPINE BLAST worked home soundly from the back last time.

raceTips.comment: Wolf Junior was tested in higher grade last prep and wasn't disgraced. He's trialled nicely for this and looks to have returned in good order. Stardarmus will get favours on speed and could be hard to rundown. Quicken Up has trialled up well.

bestBets.overview: SIMPLY DEEP has impressed working both ends to score at his past couple. From the kind draw he should have little trouble finding the front and will take plenty of wearing down again. STONE COLD STUNNER had little luck from a wide draw fresh. She was Group 3 placed two runs before the break and a much improved showing is anticipated. TUSKEGEE just failed to wear down an all-the-way leader fresh and has since won a trial here. NICCO THE GREEK has closed well to place at two of his past three outings.

raceTips.comment: Stone Cold Stunner was a little plain first up in a stronger race. Her 3rd last prep in the Group 3 Vamos Stakes reads very well for this race. She can improve sharply now fitter. Tuskegee gets in well at the weights and should get favours on speed. Simply Deep is flying and will lead here.

bestBets.overview: Former Victorian CITY WOK was confidently backed when scoring a comfortable maiden win at his local debut. The runner-up has since enhanced the form and he's a top chance for the double. COLONEL BOGEY has been kept fresh since scoring an overdue maiden win second up and won a trial here last Tuesday. BELLA CHINKARA has found the line nicely over 1200m at both runs this term and should appreciate the rise to 1350m. 1000 Guineas winner LITTLE EL has placed in both lead-in trials and any positive market moves should be respected.

raceTips.comment: City Wok won impressively first up for the new stable and looks a progressive stayer for the future. I'm surprised he's not favourite in early markets, this a perfect race for him. Colonel Bogey is very consistent and should be in the finish. Little El has the class to win here but mixes her form.

bestBets.overview: The lightly raced OZONICA strung wins together over this route to begin his career and won the latest of two lead-in trials. Expect a bold first up showing. THE REAL MAN overcome a wide run to score two starts ago, then was again too strong despite facing the breeze last time. WILD NIGHTS is holding form well and there's no reason to think that she can't play a role in the finish again. GEE GEES ME BOY was close up in a recent Hobart trial and is capable of sprinting well while new.

raceTips.comment: Ozonica is very progressive and has trialled up very well for this run. He's got plenty of upside and could be much better than this grade. The Real Man is flying for the new stable. Chicane will want further but is a track specialist.

bestBets.overview: AZONTO failed to finish off two starts ago, then let down strongly to score last time. She's been close up in a trial here since and can go on now that her confidence is back up. COASTAL STRIKE scored a deserved win at Hobart last week and must've pulled up well to be backing up here. RESPITE was successful at her first try over this trip, then battled away soundly off a tough run last time. Stablemates MATEUS and AL MAXIMUS are likely to get back and be doing their best work late.

raceTips.comment: Coastal Strike is argubly in career best form, he's flying and finds a very winnable race here. Respite looks suited on her home track. Azonto can win here but can mix his form.
